result:
The chart type gallery now shows in view mode as well as edit mode, and the dropdown no longer replaces it there. I haven't run any tests or the typechecker, as you asked.

**Cause:** `isEditableSurface` in `chartAlternativesLogic.ts` required `editMode`. In view mode `canShowAlternatives` was therefore false, and `ChartAlternatives` fell back to the plain `ChartFilter` dropdown.

**Change:** I removed the `editMode` requirement from `isEditableSurface`. The other gates are unchanged, so the gallery still doesn't show in embedded views, shared mode or dashboard tiles. It also stays hidden when the user can't edit the insight or when overrides disable editing. It still needs the existing feature flag and a trends insight.

**Behavior to be aware of:** a viewer who picks a chart type in view mode changes the displayed query the same way the old dropdown did. That is not a save.

**Not changed:** I didn't touch the `editMode` selector or the `editMode` prop on `ChartAlternatives` and `ChartGallery`, since they are still part of the logic's key. I also didn't add a test. The existing `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` only mounts with `editMode`, so a view-mode case would be a natural addition if you want one.
